name: Turbo Dash
description: A colorful endless runner platformer. Evolve mid-run to unlock the double jump and glide, spend coins in the shop on hats, packs and trails, and chase a live shared leaderboard. Keyboard and touch.
author: CaisoGames AI Team

touch.description: Tap anywhere to jump, hold for a higher jump. Landscape recommended.

features: Three-stage in-run evolution: RUNNER -> WINGED (double jump) -> BLAZE (triple jump + glide)
Evolution Cores earned by completing missions, collected on the track ahead
Air jumps set velocity rather than adding it, so every one is a reliable recovery
Each successive air jump is weaker, keeping the height ceiling bounded
Gap sizes scale with each form's MEASURED reach, so evolving never trivialises the level
Stage score multipliers (x1.0 / x1.25 / x1.6) reward evolving early
Form resets on death - losing a BLAZE run is the strongest restart pressure in the game
Coyote time and jump buffering so deaths always feel earned
Coin combo multiplier up to x8, plus close-call and big-air bonuses
Three rotating missions per run with per-mission difficulty tiers
Persistent records, rank and lifetime coins via localStorage
Power-ups: magnet, shield, and a temporary extra air jump
Four crossfading biomes: Meadow, Sunset Ridge, Midnight, Frost Peaks
Screen shake, hit-stop, speed lines and WebAudio sound with no asset files
Full touch support with multi-finger hold tracking and iOS audio unlock
Boot screen that explains itself if a sandboxed viewer blocks its scripts
Shop with three slots: hats, back packs and trails, bought with coins earned by playing
Strong items are gated on a distance RECORD as well as price - price alone gates time, not skill
Item effects chosen so none can inflate a score: the coin bonus pays the wallet only, and the slow pack trades scoring rate for reaction time
Cloud leaderboard over the artifact db capability: live top 20, one row per player
Name prompt via a real HTML input, so phones get their keyboard and accessibility
The game is complete without the cloud - the board falls back to this device's best

primary: Multi-jump physics with coyote time and jump buffering
unique: Missions pay out a visible ability rather than an abstract score bonus
A power curve inside a single run: weak, strong, unstoppable
Form is lost on death, so loss aversion drives the restart
Gaps sized from each form's measured physics, not an estimate
Shop perks are designed so buying power cannot buy leaderboard position

tiers.name: Meadow
tiers.description: Wide platforms, generous gaps, no spikes for the first 400m

tiers.name: Midnight
tiers.description: Faster scroll, tighter gaps, staircase climbs

tiers.name: Frost Peaks
tiers.description: Near top speed, maximum gap ratio, frequent spikes

knownLimitations: Must be opened in a real browser or from a web address. In-app file previews (the sheet with an x and a share button) sandbox the page and block its scripts via CSP, which fires no error and does not trigger <noscript>; the game detects this and shows an explanation instead of a blank canvas.

coverage: explains itself when a sandboxed preview blocks its scripts
evolution stages, air-jump physics and glide
a missed Evolution Core is re-offered rather than lost
hardest generated gap stays well inside each form's measured reach
shop economy: pricing, ownership, equip, and no double purchase
money alone cannot unlock the record-gated items
coin bonus reaches the wallet but never the score
menus pause the run instead of letting it play on unseen
cloud leaderboard subscribes, submits one row, and sanitises other viewers' data
the game is complete with no cloud at all

stages.name: WINGED
stages.earnedBy: Complete one mission during the run, then collect the Evolution Core

stages.name: BLAZE
stages.earnedBy: Complete a second mission, then collect the next Core

progression.note: Evolution is per-run and resets on death. Mission difficulty tiers persist, so cores get harder to earn over time.

shop.currency: Coins collected while running, banked into a wallet at the end of each run
shop.designRule: Nothing sold may inflate a score. Coin bonuses pay the wallet only; the slow pack reduces scoring rate as well as difficulty; the strongest two items additionally require a distance record, because a price tag gates patience rather than skill.

items.effect: start each run with a shield
world 8% slower - and scoring 8% slower with it

leaderboard.shape: One document per player keyed by a per-browser id; live top 20 via orderBy(score,desc).limit(20).onSnapshot
leaderboard.identity: Self-declared name in localStorage. No verified user identity is available to the page, so this is a friendly board, not anti-cheat.
leaderboard.degradation: Outside the artifact viewer there is no window.claude at all, so the board falls back to this device's own best and the game is otherwise unchanged.
leaderboard.constraint: The db capability cannot be combined with public sharing, so the cloud build is organization-internal. A separate public build ships without db.
leaderboard.untrustedInput: Rows are written by other viewers: names are stripped of control characters and capped, and numbers are coerced before display.
